flammable: Catches fire: fire on its square sets it burning, and while it burns it lights the square under it.
creature: Alive: it moves on its own, takes statuses (wet, frozen, burning) and is hurt.
conducts: Carries lightning: a charge reaching it passes on to what touches it.
floats: Floats on water rather than sinking.
breakable: Can be broken: it has hit points, and a hard enough blow or fall destroys it.
heavy: Too heavy to lift or throw: it can only be pushed.
brittle: Breaks when it lands hard or is struck: glass, a lantern.
